name: Artemis Gold Inc.
summary: Artemis Gold Inc. engages in the identification, acquisition, and development of gold properties in Canada. The company explores for gold and silver deposits. Its flagship asset is its 100% owned Blackwater Gold project, which consists of 328 mineral claims covering an area of 148,688 ha located in central British Columbia. Artemis Gold Inc. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
